sections.changelog:
1.37.0 — glossary archive title + premium project profile

  • Glossary archive now shows a clean Hebrew document title ("מילון מונחי נדל״ן…") instead of the default "ארכיון NadLan Glossary".
  • Single project pages get the premium colour profile header (banner, project-type pill, units/status/developer, gov source badge, "request info" lead CTA) — parity with professional profiles, which were bare before.

1.36.0 — FIX: projects directory was never live

  • v1.33.0 PR claimed to ship the premium projects directory but the code never landed on main; /projects/ has been falling through to the old paginated archive-grid this whole time. This release actually ships the premium projects directory: colour pills (תמ״א 38 / פינוי בינוי / בנייה חדשה / התחדשות), live AJAX filter+sort+search, load-more (NO pagination), 941 cards. archive-grid.php no longer grabs nadlan_project. v1.35.0 number was skipped (locked to Codex PR #17 which is closed).

1.34.0 — revenue rails + Lead Ledger + AI Concierge

  • Tier-upgrade CTA now opens the LIVE checkout (WooCommerce + Green Invoice/Morning) directly — Pro ₪349 + Premier ₪749, with FIRSTMONTHFREE coupon highlighted. No more "request a quote" stub.
  • NEW Lead Ledger (inc/lead-ledger.php): every referral creates a tracked nadlan_referral record with unique token, partner accepts terms via 1-click link (logged + IP-stamped = paper trail), CUSTOMER (not partner) confirms outcome at 14/30/60 days via tokenised /referral-status/ page, commission ledger logs owed vs paid, admin dashboard with KPIs. Solves the "deal closed and nobody paid me" problem with structural lock-in.
  • NEW AI Concierge (inc/ai-concierge.php): floating chat widget powered by Anthropic Claude API (haiku-4-5), RAG over our glossary + directory + pages, lead capture on intent, settings page for API key + usage/cost tracking. /nadlan/v1/concierge REST is the universal channel (WhatsApp/Telegram/external agents can hit it too).

1.33.0 — projects directory + REAL reviews engine (the moat)

  • /projects/ rebuilt as a premium directory mirroring /professionals/ (pink/purple/blue/green colour-coded project-type pills with icons + counts, sidebar facets, live AJAX filter/sort/search/load-more, 941 cards with city + units + יזם + status).
  • NEW reviews engine on nadlan_professional + nadlan_project: 5-star public reviews, moderation queue (CPT pending → publish), AggregateRating + Review schema.org JSON-LD (Google rich snippets in SERP = SEO juice), summary + recent reviews list + submission form auto-appended on every profile, admin email on every submission. Anti-spam: honeypot + 3/hour rate-limit + 30-day dup guard.
  • Reviews recompute the rating + reviews_count meta on every approval so the directory cards instantly show real ratings.

1.32.0 — premium professional profile pages

  • Single professional pages now open with a premium colour profile header (profession-coloured banner + avatar, trust badges incl. official רשם הקבלנים, rating area, call + "request a quote" lead CTA) above the existing details.
  • Added a "similar professionals" section (same profession/city) for discovery + internal linking.

1.31.0 — state-of-the-art professionals directory

  • /professionals/ rebuilt as a premium, colourful directory: gradient hero with search, colour-coded profession quick-pills with icons + live counts, sidebar facets (verified-only, top cities with counts), and premium colour-accented cards (avatar, profession pill, official רשם-הקבלנים trust badge, rating stars, location, CTA).
  • LIVE AJAX filtering & sorting (no page reload) via new /nadlan/v1/directory REST endpoint; "load more" pagination; active-filter chips; URL stays shareable.
  • City filter now partial-match (LIKE) so "תל אביב" finds "תל אביב יפו" — fixes the zero-results bug. Removed the duplicate facets form. Clean Hebrew page title (no more "Archive:").

1.30.0

  • CRITICAL FIX: directory archives (/professionals/, /projects/, /properties/) were showing only 5 of 2,702 records because the tier-priority sort forced an INNER JOIN on paid_tier meta, excluding every record without a tier set. Switched to a meta_query that returns ALL records and orders by date; tier priority will resume once we have tiered records. Also fixes city/profession filters that appeared broken (almost nothing left to filter).

1.29.0

  • Directory archive pages (/professionals/, /projects/, /properties/) now render real branded card grids instead of an empty theme page — fixes "empty archive" on every list link.
  • Homepage + footer "projects" link now points to /projects/ (the 941-project list) instead of the urban-renewal text page.
  • Cleaned whitespace padding in imported gov.il fields; ItemList schema on archives.

1.26.0

  • /catalog/ is now a directory hub: three premium category cards (registered professionals with live import count + pulse, urban-renewal projects, properties) each linking to its archive, with the featured-contractors showcase below. Replaces the empty property grid; if real properties exist they render between the hub and the showcase.

1.25.0

  • Homepage discoverability hero: 4 premium pillar cards on the front page linking to the actually-valuable destinations (professional directory with live count, glossary, urban-renewal, lawyer guide). Fixes the "no one knows where these pages are" gap.
  • Nav links added for /professionals/ and /glossary/; footer links for both as a fallback.
  • Featured professionals showcase: auto-injects a "מומחי נדל"ן רשומים" block at the top of /catalog/ showing 12 rotating real contractors from the gov.il import (was rendering empty after the demo properties were unpublished). Also exposes [nadlan_featured_pros count=N city=...].

1.24.0

  • Directory cards restyled to match the premium catalog skin: rounded card-framed facts table with zebra rows + soft shadow, gallery images with rounded corners + hover zoom, gradient gold claim CTA. The imported contractor/project cards now look premium.

1.23.0

  • Self-seeding catalog: after update, a background wp-cron auto-imports the gov.il contractor + urban-renewal datasets (one batch per tick, spaced) until the directory has ~1500 cards — no button, no owner action. Populates the empty catalog automatically.
  • Headless import runner: POST /nadlan/v1/import-run (Application Password) runs N batches server-side and returns progress, for on-demand top-ups.

1.22.0

  • Catalog premium skin: scoped WooCommerce store restyle (brand gold/ink/cream, Heebo) — shiny product cards with hover lift + image zoom, gold price + sale pills, on-brand buttons, polished single-product/cart/checkout. Loads only on Woo views.
  • Glossary auto-linker: first occurrence of any published glossary term in posts/pages/pillars auto-links to /glossary/, capped 4/page, skips headings + existing links. Builds internal links into the glossary automatically.
  • Glossary discoverability: added to primary nav + footer link (the archive was live but unlinked).

1.21.0

  • Glossary terms now render a "מונחים קשורים" related-terms block (up to 6 same-category siblings, cached 12h) — builds the topical cluster and internal-link equity on every published term.

1.20.0

  • One-shot glossary publish: POST /nadlan/v1/glossary-publish creates+enriches+publishes a nadlan_term in a single auth-able call (Application Password / Basic Auth — no browser nonce required). Idempotent by title or term_en, auto-creates categories, pings IndexNow. Removes the 3-call/2-auth-surface friction Cowork was hitting when the Chrome extension dropped.

1.19.0

  • Calculator lead-magnets (rulebook §9.3): [nadlan_calc_purchase_tax] (filterable dated brackets + verify link), [nadlan_calc_capital_gains] (estimate-only + lawyer/tax CTA), [nadlan_calc_yield] (gross/net), [nadlan_calc_equity] (BoI LTV), [nadlan_calc_total_cost]. Client-side, YMYL-careful with source disclaimers; brackets updatable via nadlan_purchase_tax_brackets filter.

1.18.0

  • GA4 direct-tag default set to FALSE — Site Kit is confirmed already tagging G-G3QRV5646E (the earlier no-data was Site Kit excluding logged-in/admin views; verified in incognito). Default-off prevents double-counting with no wp-config edit. Toggle back via define(NADLAN_GA4_HARDCODE,true) only if Site Kit is removed.

1.17.0

  • Glossary/encyclopedia engine: nadlan_term CPT at /glossary/ + nadlan_term_cat taxonomy; per-term render (definition + practical block + source + cross-link UP to money pillar); DefinedTerm/DefinedTermSet JSON-LD (GEO/AI bait); A-Z [nadlan_glossary_index]; thin-content noindex until enriched; import-enrich now accepts nadlan_term. Home for the English-Wikipedia-orphan term project.

1.16.0

  • Tiered paywall on directory cards (rulebook §10: Free/Pro/Premier). New paid_tier meta + 30-day trial on every claim approval. Free post-trial: facts visible (still indexable), but phone/email/website/photos HIDDEN + 'שדרגו לפרו' CTA that fires a lead. Pro: contact + photos + leads. Premier: Pro + 'מאומת' badge + priority sort in archives/hubs. REST sanitizes gated meta. Admin meta box per card. Healthcheck reports tier counts. Closes the 'free links + free contacts' leak vs nadlanmaster.

1.15.0

  • City/professional/project autocomplete: GET /nadlan/v1/suggest backed by a 24h cached city index (with per-city counts); sitewide JS auto-wires every input[name="city"] (keyboard nav + count display); invalidates on card save. Powers facets, saved-search, AVM tool, NL search consistently.

1.14.0

  • Archive facets: server-side pre_get_posts on properties/projects/professionals (city, listing_type, rooms_min, price min/max, project_type, profession) + [nadlan_facets] UI + auto-prepend on archives. Crawl-safe: ONLY valuable combos (city, city+rooms, city+price, etc.) are indexable; deeper combos noindex,follow to avoid scaled-content abuse.
  • Breadcrumbs: visible Hebrew RTL trail on card singles + archives + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (skips when Yoast already emits it).

1.13.0

  • NadLan Ops admin page: at-a-glance dashboard for leads (drip states), claims (pending/approved), cards (counts + claimed + enriched), imports (CKAN offsets), auctions (live/extended/sold/bids), data layer (deals/saved-searches/e-sign). Single page, manage_options gated.

1.12.0

  • Archive map: Leaflet + leaflet.markercluster (CDN, OSM tiles, no key), RTL-aware, REST /nadlan/v1/map (≤500 pts, lat/lng/title/price), [nadlan_map] shortcode + auto-prepend on /properties/ archive.
  • Lead nurture drip engine: 6-step Hebrew sequence over 0→60d (welcome, contract-tips, saved-search, check-in, market-update, re-engage), state machine (active→mid→long→archive), opt-out token + REST, daily cron, filterable steps.

1.11.0

  • Compare listings (Zillow/Redfin parity): localStorage tray + /compare/ side-by-side table (up to 4 properties, real meta incl. ₪/sqm), REST /nadlan/v1/compare.
  • Nearby POI panel via OpenStreetMap Overpass (free, no key): schools/kindergartens/transit/shops/health within 1km of lat,lng, 24h cache per coord-bucket, fail-silent.
  • e-Sign adapter (pluggable; hooks nadlan_auction_closed=sold): generates Hebrew offer letter + emails winner; provider URL via nadlan_esign_create_request filter (BoldSign/Dropbox Sign etc.). LEGAL: per IL Electronic Signature Law 5761-2001 e-sign is NOT valid for property conveyances/land-registry — scope is offer/engagement letter only; the actual שטר מכר remains handwritten via לויאר. Built-in disclaimer in every document.

1.10.0

  • Programmatic SEO city hubs: /city/{city}/{contractors|projects|properties}/ auto-render, real-data (counts + cached deal stats + top cards), CollectionPage+ItemList JSON-LD, dedicated sitemap. Floor: ≥5 cards per hub or 404; weaker hubs (5-9 cards) noindex,follow. 2026 best-practice: ≥25-30% unique data per page, quality over volume, anti-doorway compliant.
  • Rich media: 3D tour (Kuula JS embed; auto-extracts post id) + video (oEmbed) + floorplan image/PDF in a tabbed block on property singles. tour_url/video_url/floorplan_url REST meta. VideoObject JSON-LD when video present. Matterport replaced with Kuula per Zillow's Oct 2025 vendor change.

1.9.0

  • AI features (compliance-first): listing description generator with HUD Fair-Housing + IL חוק איסור הפליה guardrails in the prompt + post-generation steering-phrase scan (Hebrew+English) that holds flagged drafts for editor review; natural-language Hebrew property search (LLM→structured filter→WP_Query) with deterministic regex fallback + 1h cache; pluggable nadlan_llm_request adapter (default Anthropic, gated on NADLAN_LLM_API_KEY).

1.8.0

  • Saved searches + email alerts: nadlan_saved_search CPT, double opt-in (token email), daily cron matches new listings against confirmed searches, [nadlan_save_search] form, rate-limited public REST.

1.7.0

  • Deal-history + AVM + neighborhood layer: cached wp_nadlan_deals table, comparable-sales AVM with confidence/FSD score + explainable range (degrades gracefully when sparse), neighborhood stats, GET /nadlan/v1/avm, POST /nadlan/v1/deals-ingest (Cowork-verified endpoints slot in via nadlan_deals_remote filter), on-listing valuation block + [nadlan_home_value] seller lead funnel.

1.6.0

  • Listing engagement UX: similar listings, favorites (REST + localStorage fallback), view counter + days-on-market badges, ₪ mortgage calculator [nadlan_mortgage], schedule-viewing + WhatsApp CTA (reuses lead endpoint).

1.5.0

  • Directory cards: project + professional (contractor/service-provider) meta + free-card claim funnel (claim REST endpoint, admin approval, owner edits own card via map_meta_cap).
  • Importer: pulls רשם הקבלנים (~14k) + התחדשות עירונית (~938) from data.gov.il CKAN (idempotent upsert by source_id); admin dashboard buttons + WP-CLI `wp nadlan import` + REST import-enrich for the Cowork/ChatGPT enrichment pipeline.
  • Auction engine: timed auctions with proxy/auto-bid, hidden reserve, soft-close anti-sniping, buyer's premium; custom wp_nadlan_bids table; auctions/v1 REST (state, bids, place-bid with per-auction GET_LOCK).
  • SEO: JSON-LD per card (GeneralContractor/ApartmentComplex/RealEstateListing) + thin-content noindex guard so stub cards never index or cannibalize until enriched.

1.4.0

  • GA4 direct tag (G-G3QRV5646E) emitted in wp_head so the owner's GA4 property starts collecting (site was only tagging GT-W6VHT5TK via Site Kit). Guarded by NADLAN_GA4_HARDCODE constant; consolidate onto one tag/property later to avoid double-counting.

1.3.0

  • robots.txt via robots_txt filter with Sitemap reference.
  • Disable wptexturize on titles/content/excerpts (fixes en-dash auto-conversion AI-tell).

1.2.1

  • Strip ALL <meta name=generator> (including Site Kit's, not just WP core).
  • Property meta fields exposed for REST writes (listing_type, price, rooms, sqm, lat/lng, sponsored flags, etc.).
  • Healthcheck augmented via proper filter; now reports indexnow.key_present + recent_pings for verification.

1.2.0

  • Self-hosted auto-update via plugin-update-checker.
  • IndexNow auto-ping on save_post.
  • Catalog CPTs (property/project/professional).
  • Public lead REST endpoint.
  • Generator meta removed.
